description: Browse and retrieve U.S. legislative bill data from Congress.gov. Discover bills by filtering on congress, bill type, and date range — there is no keyword search. Use 'list' to browse (requires congress, defaults to most-recently-updated first), 'get' for full bill detail (sponsor, policy area, CBO estimates, law info), or drill into a specific bill with 'actions', 'amendments', 'cosponsors', 'committees', 'subjects', 'summaries', 'text', 'titles', or 'related' (each requires congress + billType + billNumber). 'text' lists the published versions and their format URLs; 'content' then reads one version's actual text, a bounded character window at a time. 'summaries' takes an optional versionCode selector and returns each row's text a bounded character window at a time — a row past the window carries textTotalCharacters/textTruncated/textNextOffset, and characterOffset reads on from there. An 'actions' row that records a roll call vote carries rollVote — the chamber, congress, session, and voteNumber congressgov_roll_votes takes to return that vote and each member's position. An 'amendments' row's type and number, with congress, are the amendmentType and amendmentNumber congressgov_amendment_lookup takes to return that amendment's sponsor, actions, cosponsors, and text.

anyOf.description: Digit-string form, as list rows carry it.

billNumber.description: Bill number. Required for get and sub-resource operations. Accepts the digit-string form list rows carry (e.g. "9479") as well as a number.

billType.description: Bill type code. Required for get and sub-resource operations.

characterLimit.description: Maximum characters to return (1-100000) — for the document window on 'content', and for each row's summary text on 'summaries'. Legislative documents run past a million characters and an enacted bill's summary past two hundred thousand, so either takes several windows.

characterOffset.description: First character to return, 0-based — of the document on 'content', and of every returned row's summary text on 'summaries'. Offsets are exact and are never snapped to a section or paragraph break, so feeding back the response's nextOffset (or a summary row's textNextOffset) walks the whole text with every character returned exactly once.

format.description: Document format for 'content'. 'text' is GPO's Formatted Text — plain, pre-formatted print output, published for every document checked. 'xml' prefers United States Legislative Markup and falls back to Formatted XML; it exists on some bill text versions and on no committee report or Congressional Record article. PDF is not retrieved — read one at the format URLs 'text'/'articles' return.

fromDateTime.description: Start of date range filter (ISO 8601), for 'list' only. Filters by the bill's update date — when Congress.gov last touched the record — not by the bill's latest legislative action. Other operations ignore it and say so in the notice.

order.description: Sort order for 'list' (sorts by update date). 'recent' (default) is newest first; 'oldest' is ascending. Ignored by other operations.

textVersionIndex.description: Which text version 'content' reads: the version's 0-based position in the rows 'text' returns, counted across pages. Dated versions run newest first, but an enrolled bill's undated Enrolled Bill version is 0 and an enacted bill's Public Law version is last, so read 'text' first: each row carries the textVersionIndex that reads it. Ignored by other operations.

toDateTime.description: End of date range filter (ISO 8601), for 'list' only. Same field semantics as fromDateTime.

versionCode.description: Which summary version 'summaries' returns — the versionCode a summary row carries ('00' introduced, '49' public law). Selection runs over the bill's whole summary list, which Congress.gov publishes no filter for, and limit/offset then page the matching rows. Omit to return every version. Ignored by other operations.

name: congressgov_bill_lookup

data.description: Result rows for `list` and the sub-resource operations.

items.description: Upstream JSON record: a bill (`list`) or a sub-resource row. An `actions` row carries `rollVote` when it records one roll call vote congressgov_roll_votes serves; a `text` row carries `textVersionIndex`, the index 'content' reads it by.

rollVote.description: Arguments for congressgov_roll_votes that retrieve the roll call vote this action records — its one recordedVotes entry. Absent when the action records no vote or several, and for a vote that tool has no data for: Congress.gov publishes House roll call votes from the 115th Congress (2017) onward, and the Senate publishes roll call votes from the 101st Congress (1989) onward.

chamber.description: Chamber the vote was cast in. Pass it: congressgov_roll_votes defaults to 'house', and roll call numbers are specific to one chamber.

congress.description: Congress the vote was cast in.

session.description: Session the vote was cast in (1 or 2); roll call numbers restart each session.

textVersionIndex.description: The textVersionIndex 'content' takes to read this version: its 0-based position in the whole list, counted across pages.

effectiveQuery.description: The browse scope and applied filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: A requested bill, member, committee, report, vote, or nomination does not exist in Congress.gov. `rate_limited`: A process-local attempt budget or the shared upstream credential/IP quota was reached; upstream hourly limits vary and DEMO_KEY also has a daily quota. On a Senate vote the LIS feed could not answer, Voteview answering HTTP 429 is reported the same way. `invalid_request`: Congress.gov rejected the request as malformed — a bad date range or an identifier with an unexpected shape. `api_key_rejected`: The api.data.gov gateway rejected the server's configured CONGRESS_API_KEY (missing, invalid, disabled, unauthorized, or unverified); the gateway code is in data.upstreamCode. No change to the call's arguments can fix it. `upstream_error`: Congress.gov returned an unexpected error (5xx or another non-2xx status) or could not be reached, or a Senate vote could be read from neither the Senate LIS feed nor its Voteview fallback (before the 101st Congress there is no fallback, and there a senate.gov HTTP 403 refusal carries retryable: false). `upstream_timeout`: A Congress.gov request or a congress.gov document fetch timed out or returned an HTTP timeout response, or the call's upstream requests could not finish inside its 50-second budget. `document_unavailable`: The 'content' selection resolves to no retrievable document — the text version or article index is past the end of the list, the record publishes no formats at all, or Congress.gov does not hold the file its own metadata names. `format_unavailable`: The document exists but publishes nothing in a format this server reads — some text versions and committee reports ship PDF only, no Congressional Record article publishes XML, and the oldest CRS reports publish a PDF but no HTML. `document_fetch_failed`: www.congress.gov did not return a readable document — a non-2xx status, a network failure, an empty body, or a content type that is not text or XML. `document_too_large`: The document is larger than the byte ceiling this server retrieves, so no character window can be served from it. `offset_past_end`: characterOffset is at or beyond the last character of every text the call would window — the document on 'content', or every returned row's summary text on 'summaries' — so the window would be empty. `incompatible_identity`: A list operation carries an entity identifier that only a detail operation uses. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty, a page is past the end, or a caveat applies.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata: total count and next offset.

count.description: Total result count across all pages.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when there are no more pages.

title: Congress.gov Bill Lookup
